cohort: Nulliparous pregnant women aged 14 to 19 years, recruited in their 2nd trimester, and their children, followed through 14 months of age.
finding: Maternal immune activation (IL-6 and CRP) during mid-to-late pregnancy was significantly associated with newborn brain metabolite concentrations, tissue microstructure, and offspring motor development at 4 and 14 months of age.
